items.quote: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation
items.claim: Someone placed the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the tabernacle tent
items.place: by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation

items.quote: and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering
items.claim: Burnt and meat offerings were made on the altar
items.object: the burnt offering and the meat offering

items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses regarding these procedures
